purpose: Fill missing Desert regional skilling coverage for Equilibrium no-trading planning: Menaphos district hub and reputation, VIP skilling, Shifting Tombs supply, soul altar, Het's Oasis prayer powders, Kharid-et Archaeology, Sophanem Pyramid Plunder black ibis (2026 rates), red sandstone flasks, and explicit non-claims (Dominion Tower combat, Master farmer = Kandarin).

policy.region_rule: region_hint marks where the unlock or activity lives in the current planner taxonomy. region_hints marks a cross-region chain. required_regions is only used when both regions are needed for a full stack, not for dual dig-site claims. Quest auto-completion and League-specific overrides must be applied separately.
policy.no_trade_rule: Prioritise unlocks that materially change self-sufficient progression, training throughput, supply access, or tool progression. Do not mirror every shop item.
policy.rate_rule: Do not promote stale XP/hour figures. Training rates belong in training datasets; this file records unlock state and effects.
already_covered: desert:garden-of-kharid-rewards lives in progression-enrichment-regional-skilling-outfits-2026-07-25 — not re-added here
desert:pyramid-plunder-black-ibis and desert:red-sandstone-potion-flasks from 2026-07-25 are enriched in-place (same ids) with 2026 current rules

activity_additions.name: Menaphos skilling hub (four districts)
requirements: Partial completion of The Jack of Spades for city access in the normal game
Equilibrium intends Desert region unlock to provide near-immediate Menaphos access — keep skill gates on individual activities
unlocks: Imperial district: acadia trees (50 Woodcutting), VIP skilling gate, Grand Library, soul ruins / soul altar path, Imperial cactus patch construction
Merchant district: Menaphite marketeers and stalls (46+ Thieving), Summoning obelisk, GE/bank access after Jack of Spades
Port district: desert sole / catfish / beltfish spots (52/60/72 Fishing), furnaces, anvils, spinning wheels, looms, Player-owned port portal, Portmaster Kags desert ferry
Worker district: mineral deposits (50 Mining), clay, furnace, anvil, bonfire, pottery oven, ranges
Shifting Tombs entrances in every district (district quick-travel)
Menaphos reputation factions tied to each district plus overall city tiers
activity_additions.notes: Treat Menaphos like Prifddinas: a bundle of gather, production, minigame, and reputation infrastructure rather than one training method. Local fish + ranges form the midgame food cook loop (desert sole / catfish / beltfish). Sophanem is the twin city for Pyramid Plunder, plover birds, and Slayer dungeon — not a separate league region.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Desert official examples include Menaphos and Het's Oasis. Keep skill requirements on VIP, soul altar, Shifting Tombs tiers, and individual resources.

activity_additions.name: Menaphos reputation and VIP skilling area
requirements: Menaphos access and a selected reputation faction
Tier 7 overall Menaphos reputation for VIP skilling area access
District tiers for deposit boxes (tier 2), teleports (tier 4), bank chests (tier 6), and district skilling boosts (tier 8)
unlocks: VIP skilling area (Imperial): 4 acadia trees, 3 mineral deposits, 3 Menaphos fish spots, bank chest with Deposit all fish; resources deplete at half the outside rate
Overall tier 5: improved Shifting Tombs feather of Ma'at and gold rewards
District tier 8 permanent success/damage boosts: Imperial Woodcutting, Port Fishing, Merchant Thieving (marketeers), Worker Mining damage on sandstone deposits (also applies inside VIP)
City-quest cooldown reductions scaling with overall reputation (none at overall tier 8+)
Quest multipliers on reputation gain up to x2.5 after Pharaoh's Folly
activity_additions.notes: VIP is the high-value midgame Desert gather hub once overall tier 7 is banked. Reputation is earned from city skilling, Shifting Tombs, City Quests, soul obelisks, and related desert activities — not spent. Do not invent XP/hour for VIP; surface the permanent infrastructure and tier gates only.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Hard Desert / Menaphos reputation grind. VIP is a permanent gather QoL unlock, not a one-off shop purchase.

activity_additions.name: Shifting Tombs (Menaphos supply and multi-skill XP)
requirements: The Jack of Spades completed for access
Tier 1: 50+ Dungeoneering, Agility, Thieving, Construction
Tier 2: 70+ in primary and secondary skills; Tier 3: 90+ (boosts do not work)
unlocks: Selectable primary XP: Dungeoneering, Agility, Thieving, Construction (or coins if all statues off)
Selectable secondary XP: Crafting, Runecrafting, Prayer, Divination
Menaphos reputation on successful timed exits
Feathers of Ma'at from treasure chests (Sophanem Slayer supply)
Soul talisman chance (1/200) from sarcophagi — safer ironman soul-altar path than feline akhs
Camouflage fragments for master camouflage outfit at ~5x normal Thieving fragment rate on full clears
District Shifting Tombs entrances as Menaphos quick-travel
activity_additions.notes: Core Desert multi-skill minigame and reputation engine. Must exit via rope before the timer for completion rewards; timed-out runs grant no completion XP/reputation/fragments. Overall reputation tier 5 improves feather/gold rewards. Do not paste XP/hour tables here.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Desert-defining skilling activity. Keep skill tier gates; League XP multipliers do not remove the multi-skill entry requirements.

activity_additions.name: Soul altar (Menaphos Imperial)
requirements: 'Phite Club completed to access soul ruins under the Imperial fountain
90 Runecrafting to craft soul runes (boostable from lower levels for first crafts)
Soul talisman / tiara / omni / wicked hood path or Abyss access to enter
Pure essence supply for the charge-and-craft mechanic
unlocks: Soul rune production via charger + altar (unique charge workflow vs standard altars)
Soul runes for high-level Magic, Summoning-adjacent costs, and skilling spells that demand souls

activity_additions.league_treatment: Hard Desert for altar location. Abyss ferry remains optional multi-region pressure, not a second Desert claim.

activity_additions.name: Het's Oasis whirligigs and prayer powder production
requirements: Het's Oasis access (Desert; ring of duelling option)
Hunter 16–90 by whirligig tier (speedy / powder of burials at 90 Hunter)
Farming 30–90 for oasis flower bushes that supply lure flowers (hollyhocks at 90 for burials)
Flower baskets built (Construction) to stock lure flowers at each pond
unlocks: Prayer powders from ground whirligig shells (15 shells per powder except penance)
Powder of burials: +250% base Prayer XP when burying bones for 30 minutes (350% total base); stacks duration to 1 hour; works with bonecrusher
Powder of pulverising, penance, defence, protection, item protection as the other shell products
Dundee crocodile Hunter upgrades (catch rate, double loot, flower save, auto-loot, stack size)
Holy scarab Summoning pouch path from mixed whirligig shells (80 Summoning)
Het's Oasis Agility course (65 Agility) and active Farming flower bushes for PoF honeycombs
activity_additions.notes: Official Equilibrium Desert example. Powder of burials is the region-defining Prayer bank-stand supply; bone sources and bonecrusher remain multi-region. Does not work with demonic ashes, ectoplasmator, Double XP Prayer rules shared with gilded altars, or Dragon Rider amulet. Do not invent catch rates or XP/hour.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Desert owns powder production. Pair with multi-region bone supply and Forinthry bonecrusher for the full Prayer stack (see combo:prayer-powder-desert-bones).

requirements: 5 Archaeology to begin exterior excavation
What Lies Beneath? mystery / Dr Nabanik entry path for fortress progression
Higher-level hotspots through prison, chapel, vault, and praetorium (up to 107+)
unlocks: Early-to-late Archaeology ladder on Desert geography (venator remains through praetorian content)
Pylon battery turn-ins for Protection of Zaros (+10% Archaeology XP, +5% mattock precision while charged)
Shadow anchors and praetorium access for inquisitor staff piece rolls
Vault of Hereditas heist entrance (95 Thieving) as Desert Archaeology/Thieving crossover
Zarosian materials and artefacts feeding collections and production research

activity_additions.league_treatment: Hard Desert Archaeology geography. Inquisitor staff and heist are Desert pressures, not global freebies.

activity_additions.name: Pyramid Plunder and black ibis outfit
requirements: Sophanem / Jalsavrah Pyramid access (Desert; Icthlarin's Little Helper path in the normal game)
Pyramid Plunder unlocked
unlocks: Black ibis outfit (mask, body, legs, boots)
1% Thieving XP per piece; +1% set bonus for 5% total when full set worn
Master camouflage outfit inherits the highest black-ibis XP bonus previously obtained
activity_additions.notes: 2026 Early-Game Rebalance (16 February 2026): base black-ibis piece chance improved to 1/800 in room 1, improving by 100 per subsequent room to 1/100 in the final room; level 78 Thieving gate removed; pieces also roll from grand gold chests and sarcophagi. Sceptre of the gods still doubles chance; tier-3+ luck still adds 3%. Do not import pre-2026 1/2300 tables. Permanent outfit unlock matters more than raw room XP.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Treat as Desert Thieving progression even if a faster raw-XP method exists elsewhere. Overwrites the thinner 2026-07-25 row with current drop rules.
